requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Show that you know first aid for injuries or illnesses that could occur while scuba diving, including hypothermia, hyperventilation, squeezes, decompression illness, nitrogen narcosis, motion sickness, fatigue, overexertion, heat reactions, dehydration, injuries by aquatic life, and cuts and scrapes. (b) Identify the conditions that must exist before performing CPR on a person, and explain how to recognize such conditions. Demonstrate the proper technique for performing CPR using a training device approved by your counselor.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 6): Find out about three career opportunities in the scuba industry.
Core Standard 2 (Req 6): Pick one and find out the education, training, and experience required for this profession.
Core Standard 3 (Req 6): Discuss this with your counselor, and explain why this profession might interest you.
Counselor Conference Readiness: Record concrete observations, examples, and sketches in your Scuba Diving Workbook before requesting Requirement 6 sign-off.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 6): Review the official Scuba Diving requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Scuba Diving Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the research task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Scuba Diving Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
